description: Final PAM-site comparison table and figure with within-clade conservation and physicochemical change
code:
import numpy as np, os, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter
OUT=os.getcwd()
tab=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"pam_site_mapping.json")))
pa_cols=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"pseudomonas_pam_survey.json")))["P_aeruginosa"]["cols"]
ec_cols=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"ecoli_pam_survey.json")))["E_coli_K12like"]["cols"]

rows=[]
for r in tab:
    p=str(r["ec_pos"]); q=str(r["pa_pos"])
    ecc=Counter(ec_cols[p]); pac=Counter(pa_cols[q])
    ecm=ecc.most_common(1)[0]; pam=pac.most_common(1)[0]
    rows.append(dict(ec=f'{r["ec_aa"]}{r["ec_pos"]}', pa=f'{pam[0]}{r["pa_pos"]}', role=r["role"],
        ca=float(r["ca_dist"]), ec_cons=100*ecm[1]/sum(ecc.values()), pa_cons=100*pam[1]/sum(pac.values()),
        ec_mode=ecm[0], pa_mode=pam[0], same=(ecm[0]==pam[0]), chg=bool(r["charge_change"]), dvol=int(r["dvol"])))
print(f"{'E.coli':>7} {'P.aer':>7} {'role':<18} {'CA(A)':>6} {'Ec%':>5} {'Pa%':>5} {'same':>5} {'chg':>4} {'dVol':>6}")
for r in rows:
    print(f"{r['ec']:>7} {r['pa']:>7} {r['role']:<18} {r['ca']:6.2f} {r['ec_cons']:5.0f} {r['pa_cons']:5.0f} "
          f"{'yes' if r['same'] else 'NO':>5} {'Y' if r['chg'] else '':>4} {r['dvol']:>+6}")
print(f"\nidentical at clade consensus: {sum(1 for r in rows if r['same'])}/{len(rows)}; "
      f"charge changes: {sum(1 for r in rows if r['chg'])}; "
      f"high-confidence mappings (CA<3.5 A): {sum(1 for r in rows if r['ca']<3.5)}/{len(rows)}")
json.dump(rows, open(os.path.join(OUT,"pam_site_table.json"),"w"))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12.5,5.2))
x=np.arange(len(rows))
colors=["#9aa5b1" if r["same"] else ("#c0392b" if r["chg"] else "#e8a33d") for r in rows]
ax.bar(x,[r["dvol"] for r in rows],color=colors,edgecolor="k",lw=0.4)
ax.axhline(0,color="k",lw=0.9)
for i,r in enumerate(rows):
    ax.text(i, r["dvol"]+(7 if r["dvol"]>=0 else -18), r["pa"], ha="center", fontsize=7.5)
    if r["ca"]>3.5: ax.text(i, 2, "*", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=14)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{r['ec']}\n{r['role'].split(' ')[0]}" for r in rows], rotation=90, fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_ylabel("side chain volume, P. aeruginosa minus E. coli (A$^3$)")
ax.set_xlabel("E. coli K-12 Cse1 residues within 4 A of the PAM duplex in PDB 5H9F; label above bar is the P. aeruginosa consensus residue")
ax.set_title("The Cas8e PAM recognition site differs at 18 of 21 positions between E. coli K-12 and P. aeruginosa\n"
             "red = charge change, orange = other substitution, grey = identical, * = CA mapping distance above 3.5 A")
ax.set_ylim(-115,100)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
